nearest_spacing.method: Exact nearest other return within full 60 x 60 m patch; 256 deterministic lexicographic interior queries with 5 m XY margin. Overlaps/duplicates retained; not independent resolution.

summit_cliff.query_selection: lexicographic spread among returns with 2 m XY margin; all classifications, no random population claim

0.5.reliability: at least 10 returns, planarity >=0.3, plane RMS <=min(0.1,radius*0.1) m, split-fit angle <=10 deg; heuristic, not accuracy CI
0.5.coherence_screen: Within 2*radius in 3-D, >=2 other reliable queries with acute normal separation <15 deg; diagnostic sample support, not independent accuracy or population coverage

1.0.reliability: at least 10 returns, planarity >=0.3, plane RMS <=min(0.1,radius*0.1) m, split-fit angle <=10 deg; heuristic, not accuracy CI
1.0.coherence_screen: Within 2*radius in 3-D, >=2 other reliable queries with acute normal separation <15 deg; diagnostic sample support, not independent accuracy or population coverage

2.0.reliability: at least 10 returns, planarity >=0.3, plane RMS <=min(0.1,radius*0.1) m, split-fit angle <=10 deg; heuristic, not accuracy CI
2.0.coherence_screen: Within 2*radius in 3-D, >=2 other reliable queries with acute normal separation <15 deg; diagnostic sample support, not independent accuracy or population coverage

overlapping_xy_candidates.audit_criteria: Both local planes >=10 points, RMS <=0.15 m, planarity >=0.3, abs(normal.Z)>0.1; common XY at least 0.4 m within both convex footprints (2x stated horizontal sigma), separated >1 m. This remains an evidence screen, not independent accuracy validation.
overlapping_xy_candidates.note: Finite bin steep slopes, overlapping flights, classification and uncertainty can mimic multiple surfaces. No automatic overhang/non-heightfield assertion.
